title: rigor: update onboarding guide
description: Update AGENTS.md and the project onboarding guide to reflect the new src/domain and src/lattice architecture.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide clear onboarding for new agents and developers.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL present the unified architectural doctrine.

unwanted.condition: IF the onboarding guide still references intent/interview
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT pass documentation review

postconditions: AGENTS.md is synchronized with the new code structure
invariants: The onboarding guide is accessible from the root

title: rigor: final binary size check
description: Verify the release binary size and ensure that flattening/unification has not introduced bloat. Target: < 20MB.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain a minimal binary footprint.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL report the binary size in bytes.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the release to proceed

invariants: Binary size is measured without debug symbols

title: rigor: verify error User experience
description: Perform a manual walkthrough of failure modes to ensure that ClarityError variants are human-friendly and actionable in the UI.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide actionable error feedback.

event_driven.trigger: WHEN an error card is rendered
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL include a 'Why' and 'How to fix' message.

unwanted.condition: IF an error message contains raw stack traces
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT be considered user-friendly

invariants: No error variants display raw internal paths

title: rigor: prepare release notes
description: Consolidate the results of the 80 beads into a formal set of Release Notes for version 1.1.0.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL communicate changes to stakeholders.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL generate a CHANGELOG entry.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT pass release gate

invariants: Release notes are based on bead completion summaries

title: rigor: session post-mortem
description: Reflect on the unification refactor process. Identify what went well and where architectural drift might recur.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL improve its own engineering process.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL record a Post-Mortem ADR.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT be considered a learning system

invariants: Post-mortem identifies at least 3 anti-patterns found

title: rigor: cleanup planning artifacts
description: Delete all temporary task JSON files and planning session logs from the project root.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain a pristine workspace.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL purge the root directory of temp files.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT pass final audit

invariants: Git history is preserved, but workspace is fresh
